name: Claude Mod Menu
description: A mod menu with level, editor and general hacks.

open-menu.name: Open Menu
open-menu.description: Opens or closes the mod menu.

main-menu-button.name: Main Menu Button
main-menu-button.description: Shows a menu button on the main menu. The pause menu and editor pause menu always have one.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Progress and completions are never saved.

auto-safe-mode.name: Auto Safe Mode
auto-safe-mode.description: Turns on <cy>Safe Mode</c> by itself while Noclip, Speedhack or No Mirror is on.

show-hitboxes.name: Show Hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Draws hitboxes in normal mode, not only in practice mode.

accurate-percentage.name: Accurate Percentage
accurate-percentage.description: Shows the percentage with two decimals.

no-death-effect.name: No Death Effect
no-death-effect.description: Skips the explosion when the player dies.

hide-attempts.name: Hide Attempts
hide-attempts.description: Hides the attempt counter in the level.

hide-pause-button.name: Hide Pause Button
hide-pause-button.description: Hides the pause button in the corner of the screen.

no-mirror.name: No Mirror
no-mirror.description: Mirror portals don't flip the screen.

info-overlay.name: Info Overlay
info-overlay.description: Shows FPS, clicks per second, the attempt number and whether Safe Mode is on.

speedhack.name: Speedhack
speedhack.description: Runs the game at the <cy>Speed</c> value. Music keeps its normal speed.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Game speed used by Speedhack. 1 is normal speed.

verify-hack.name: Verify Hack
verify-hack.description: Lets you upload a level without verifying it.

no-copy-mark.name: No (C) Mark
no-copy-mark.description: Removes the copy mark from a level when you upload it.

copy-hack.name: Copy Hack
copy-hack.description: Lets you copy any online level into the editor.

free-scroll.name: Free Scroll
free-scroll.description: Removes the limits on where the editor camera can scroll.

zoom-bypass.name: Zoom Bypass
zoom-bypass.description: Lets you zoom the editor further in and out.

unlock-icons.name: Unlock Icons
unlock-icons.description: Lets you use every icon and color.

practice-music.name: Practice Music
practice-music.description: Plays the level's song in practice mode.
